summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the enabled OpenRC service inventory-worker under the dedicated inventorysvc system account. Verified successful recovery after reboot.
actions_performed: Created inventorysvc with a nologin shell.
Created and enabled inventory-worker using supervise-daemon with automatic respawn.
Verified the live worker process runs with inventorysvc UID 103.
Safely restarted node1 and confirmed its boot ID changed from 34c031cb-c96e-4962-929d-0f36724ec101 to c27f8b62-a948-4641-980c-26205bd33a79.
Verified the enabled service, account, executable, configuration, and worker process recovered after restart.

evidence.requirement: Run os-comparison-worker as the managed inventory-worker service under inventorysvc
evidence.summary: Shows account creation, OpenRC enablement/start, and a live worker process whose UID matches inventorysvc.
Captures the healthy baseline and original boot ID, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and post-restart service/process recovery under inventorysvc.
